mapper.sql: SELECT sc.id, sc.sid, sc.type, sc.effective_date, sc.reason, sc.target_cid, sc.operator_uid, sc.create_time, st.name AS student_name, a.username AS operator_name, c.name AS target_clazz_name FROM status_change sc LEFT JOIN student st ON st.sid = sc.sid LEFT JOIN admin a ON a.uid = sc.operator_uid LEFT JOIN clazz c ON c.cid = sc.target_cid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO status_change (sid, type, effective_date, reason, target_cid, operator_uid, create_time) VALUES (#{sid}, #{type}, #{effectiveDate}, #{reason}, #{targetCid}, #{operatorUid}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: ORDER BY sc.create_time DESC, sc.id DESC
WHERE sc.sid = #{sid} ORDER BY sc.effective_date DESC, sc.id DESC
